posts.title: Entangled cognitions: a complexivist perspective on AI and learning – slides from my invited talk at “Artificial Intelligence and the Humanities: Critical Thinking in the Algorithmic Era”, IHU, Brazil
posts.description: This presentation, Entangled Cognitions and AI: a Complexivist Perspective on AI and Learning, is an attempt to situate generative AI in the context of complexivist approaches to learning such as Connectivism, Rhizomatic Learning, Landscapes of Practice, Entanglement, Enactivism, and many other theoretical models that treat learning as a complex phenomenon. posts.title: Some things I have learned about generative AI
posts.description: I’ve been writing about genAI and education for a few years now, and my thoughts have evolved somewhat. This post is a quick, non-comprehensive summary of roughly what I think about the subject now. It is not my last word, some is mundane (but not necessarily obvious), it is very incomplete, and I won’t go into too much detail, but I think some of this is useful and worth sharing.
